ACT I: THE INCITING INCIDENT

EXT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS — DAY
The campus buzzes with students starting new lives. Kan, a freshman, walks the campus. He wants to belong. He catches up to a group of friends. Then, his wallet disappears. It holds his cash and a phone number, his only link back home.
His friend calls. Strangers send a message claiming his wallet. They pass a phone number to him. Kan is new to these streets. He needs the money. He calls the number after lectures. A voice tells him to come outside the school. He must collect it at 5 p.m.

EXT. OUTSIDE SCHOOL PREMISES — LATE AFTERNOON
Kan arrives at the meeting point. He finds a group of men. More than seven men sit there, drinking casually. They wave him over. They offer him a seat. Kan takes a seat among them. They tell him to drink. Kan tries to refuse. The mood shifts. He sees their faces harden. He knows he cannot refuse. Kan drinks. He observes the men. The detail is unknown to him. One man at the table is the group's serving executioner.
One of the men is EMK. Other rough men drift by. They greet the group. They greet EMK specifically with both hands. Kan sees the gesture. He feels an unease settle. Kan grows restless. He wants to leave. EMK's demeanor changes. He asks Kan about his studies. EMK gives Kan his personal number. He tells Kan to call if he runs into trouble. Kan leaves the group. He feels relief. He has his wallet back. EMK's number is in his pocket. He leaves with the number, unaware of what he has just entered.

ACT II: THE NEW REALITY

INT. KAN'S HOSTEL ROOM — NIGHT
Kan sits alone. He thinks about the day. He holds EMK's number. He remembers EMK's kindness. He remembers the men's faces. They are connected to him now.

ACT III: THE UNRAVELING THREAT

INT. KAN'S HOSTEL ROOM — CONTINUOUS
Kan considers his situation. He lost his wallet. He met the men. He holds EMK's number. The number is in his hand. His reality is altered.
FADE OUT.
